facts.text: The Oregon Access Scholarship provides full tuition for eligible Oregon residents whose families have an annual adjusted gross income under $80,000.

sources.title: Oregon Access Scholarship | Full-Tuition Scholarship at WU
sources.quote: Willamette University is proud to offer the Oregon Access Scholarship at Willamette College, a full-tuition scholarship designed to make a Willamette education more accessible for Oregon students.

sources.title: Oregon Access Scholarship | Full-Tuition Scholarship at WU
sources.quote: Demonstrate an adjusted gross family income of less than $80,000 annually based on information submitted through the FAFSA or ORSAA.* Have a Student Aid Index (SAI) of 0 or less.
